title: How to organise the toy and play zone | Family Room
description:
Hold the toys that are in active rotation, at a height and in a form where a child can put them away without an adult.

This is the Toy and Play Zone in the Family Room. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Five or six open bins with no lids on the lowest shelf, one category each, a photo of the contents taped to the front face where a child looking down sees it, the play mat rolled against the wall, and enough clear floor that two children can build without moving anything first.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Tip every bin out onto the mat and make four piles: played with this month, broken, missing its other half, an
Straighten: One category per open bin, no lids, all on the lowest shelf: blocks, vehicles, dolls and figures, pretend food
Shine: Wash hard plastic toys in mild soapy water and dry them fully, because a damp block goes back into a closed bi
Safety: For any child under three in the house, hold each small part against the middle of a toilet paper tube.
Standardize: Photo labels on the bin fronts, and one printed picture of the finished shelf taped at child eye height on the
Sustain: When the bedtime story is announced, the floor gets cleared first, and the story starts when the mat is empty.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Five or six open bins on the lowest shelf, one category each, picture labels on the front face, nothing above shoulder height, and the overflow toys waiting in labeled bins in a closet rather than on this shelf.
